title: Step-by-Step Guide: Create Agents in AL Code
summary: Building agents in Business Central AL involves creating setup tables, pages, codeunits, and enums to enable autonomous multi-step operations. The guide walks through creating a Cash Flow Review Agent that can accept tasks, interact with the user during execution, and display KPI results.
key_points: Agents chain multiple tasks together for complex operations, unlike single-task copilots that require review and acceptance
Required components include setup tables with User Security ID, metadata codeunits implementing IAgentFactory and IAgentMetadata interfaces, and KPI tracking tables
Custom Agent capability must be enabled in Business Central with appropriate permissions (Agent Admin and Agent Diagnostics) configured in a sandbox environment
Agent instructions are embedded as resources and delivered via the Agent.SetInstructions method using user security identifiers
Tasks are created using AgentTaskBuilder to initialize agents with titles and messages, triggering autonomous execution that may pause for user interaction

quotes.text: An agent operates slightly differently; an Agent strings several tasks together to complete a more complex overreaching operation.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the core distinction between agents and single-task copilots, defining what agents do

quotes.text: There is a security hole in this implementation.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights a critical concern developers must address when building agents with elevated permissions
